  • 英語名: Innyuu Ningyou Genmu no Yujuku “Kitsune no Mori” Yawa

あらすじ

“Fox Grove”, one of Japan’s premier hot spring inns. The source of its hot springs flows through a parallel dimension that is the homeland of youkai. Consequently, the entire inn area suffers from dimensional instability.

The yokai cannot maintain physical forms and wander in a soul-like state, sometimes causing mischief to the inn’s guests… Therefore, it had become customary at this inn to perform a ritual once a year to appease these youkai.

item.title: Midara Ryuu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Pinky Soft
  • 発売日: 2002-08-09
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 淫ら龍
  • 英語名: Midara Ryuu

あらすじ

Ikaru Dragio is the capital of the Dragion Empire. Rudin (or player’s name) has just been awarded the rank of fighter, but he has no motivation at all. His parents are highly successful business executives, and they’re now high-ranking government officials. Rudin is simply bored!

One day, as he’s looking out the window to find a girl to pick up, he notices a hunter-type girl glaring at him. Rudin rushes toward the girl to pick a fight… Later, he learns that her name is Shalvina, visiting Dragion as an exchange hunter trainee. Rudin and Shalvina start quarreling, but soon witness the space next to them suddenly tear apart. A dying woman appears from the tear!! The woman appears to have been warped from somewhere, but she dies before she can explain everything.

The Highlandy Republic and the Dragon Empire normalized their diplomatic relations through negotiations. In addition, “International highway” was built as a magical defensive means against phantom beasts.

别名

  • げんじゅうや

あらすじ

One year after events of Dragon no Tiara.

The Highlandy Republic is a democratic country blessed with mountains and forests and as such desired by its neighbors. It managed to retain its form, but the chaos of phantom beasts outburts around its borders influenced it a lot.

“Fighters” guilds spread to undertake various works for states and individuals. “Hunters” guilds specialize in hunting phantom beasts for bounties. And “Gentleman’s shop” trains phantom beasts to satisfy sexual needs of population. Main character becomes administrator of one of such shops.
